# Marianna Inozemtseva · Linkifyo Agency

> Marianna Inozemtseva is a LinkedIn strategist and ghostwriter, founder of Linkifyo Agency. She builds LinkedIn presence that brings in leads for B2B founders and executives: she writes and publishes posts in the client's voice, teaches teams to do it themselves, or coaches founders 1:1. Clients are in the US, UK, Europe, Canada, Israel and Central Asia. Based in Israel, works worldwide, in English and Russian.

Marianna writes every post personally, based on interviews with the client. AI is used only as a research tool; engagement and commenting are never automated. Success is measured by who sends connection requests after each post and whether they match the client's ideal customer profile.

## Services and pricing

- [Done-for-you LinkedIn growth](https://linkifyo.com/#services): Content + Visibility, $1,400/month, up to 8 posts a month in the client's voice, network growth among ideal clients, monthly analytics. Growth + Networking, $2,000/month, up to 12 posts a month plus handling of comments, connection requests and messages. Minimum commitment one month; first posts go live in the first week.
- [1:1 Consulting](https://linkifyo.com/#services): one session $250/hour (profile review, strategy, specific questions); mentoring $550 for 3 sessions (positioning and profile, commenting and networking, content strategy).
- [Public talks and workshops](https://linkifyo.com/#services): team workshop from $1,500 for two sessions (profiles, search, Sales Navigator, commenting, content); conference and community talks on request.

## Client results

- [Daria Yakovleva, CEO at Mira (UK)](https://linkifyo.com/#results): 524K views in 5 months, plus 17 inbound requests from investors and strategic partners.
- [Laura Zhunussova, Founder & CEO of WE Media Group](https://linkifyo.com/#results): 477K views in 10 months and 46 leads.
- [Fedor Belomoev, Founder of DMaple (Canada)](https://linkifyo.com/#results): 18 times more views per post within 2 months; 44% of readers are decision-makers.
